stemBlocks: Paper chromatography was used to separate three mixtures of amino acids. The mixtures were labelled P, Q and R. Each mixture contains some of the five amino acids in the following table. The $R_f$ values were measured for each amino acid with the solvent used to produce the chromatogram.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

1 Mixture P contains valine and glycine.
2 Leucine is found in all three mixtures.
3 Glutamic acid is the least mobile amino acid with this solvent.
4 Mixtures P and Q both contain asparagine.

| amino acid | $R_f$ value |
| --- | --- |
| asparagine | 0.50 |
| glutamic acid | 0.30 |
| glycine | 0.26 |
| leucine | 0.71 |
| valine | 0.61 |
